title: The Island
summary: The lower Amazon, the dry season 2772. On a river island below Óbidos Lindqvist breeds the creatures Rome ordered destroyed. The Crown's commission comes up the river to search it.

sides.name: The Stock
sides.about: Lindqvist's breeding stock on the island, and the people who keep it with the lures.

sides.name: The Commission
sides.about: The Crown's commission with Rome's order: Duarte Valadares, Desembargador Fonseca and their musketeers.

objectives.text: Move the stock into the deep forest, north of the creek: {deep} of {young_n} there. A creature follows orders only within reach of a lure (the green rings round Lindqvist, Pieter and the keepers): walk a keeper ahead and the creatures with him.
objectives.phone: Stock into the deep forest: {deep} of {young_n}. Keep them inside a lure's green ring.

objectives.text: Root the young Mother in the nest clearing (marked, in the middle of the deep forest): select her and press ROOT there.
The Storm Sire has hatched. Root him beside the young Mother (within a few steps of her), then pick HATCHLINGS on her card: a clutch of little flyers to watch the commission from above.

Keep the stock hidden until dusk ({clock:dusk}): {found} of {young_n} found. A creature that keeps STILL is seen only up close; one that moves is seen as far as a soldier can see. Three quarters found and Rome's order is carried out.
objectives.phone: Hide the stock till dusk ({clock:dusk}): {found} of {young_n} found. Still = seen only up close.

objectives.text: THE DINNER: walk Lindqvist to the big house's door and keep him there a moment. The magistrate and his party will dine with him for a while instead of searching.
A DECOY: stand a keeper (or Pieter) at the west point or the burnt chapel for a moment. He sets a lure post there, and the nearest search party goes to see what it is.
Keep the stock hidden through the night until the commission leaves at dawn ({clock:dawn}): {found} of {young_n} found.
A young one is up and going for the goats by the commission's camp. Get a lure RIGHT BESIDE it (3 steps: a keeper or Lindqvist) before it reaches them, then walk it back into the deep forest.

Find the specimens and destroy them by Rome's order: {destroyed} destroyed, {half} needed ({found} found). Walk your parties through the forest: a sleeping creature is seen only from 3 steps, and it wakes and fights. Pale claw marks on the ground are fresh tracks.

deny.why: Not on the island: Lindqvist breeds only from his stock.

k_open1.text: Lindqvist walked out of Rome with the animals the Council had ordered destroyed. He went home to his river.

k_open2.text: Two years later I sent Valadares up that river with Rome's order in his satchel.

l_open1.text: An island below Óbidos. Sugar for the tax man, and behind the cane, the forest, and in the forest, my pens.

l_open2.text: They were not monsters. They were a new kind of animal, and every animal can be bred. I had the lures. They came to the lures.

l_open_linnea.text: And among them her daughter. Out of the clutch we carried from the station. Growing.

l_open_plateau.text: And a young Mother we netted on the mountain. My breeding stock.

k_open_c.text: Valadares wrote me a report from that island. It is the only honest account of it I have.

v_open_c.text: We came up the river at first light. Sugar on the banks, a white house, a doctor at the landing with his hat in his hand.

l_1.text: Pieter! A boat on the river, below the point. The Crown's flag. Get them out of the old pens. All of them. Into the forest, now.

p_tip1.text: They follow the lures, Doctor, nothing else. The keepers go first, and the animals stay inside the ring. Out of it they wander.

p_tip2.text: Over the creek by a ford, then up the paths to the clearings. The young Mother roots best in the nest clearing, in the middle.

n_loose.text: A creature out of every lure's reach goes its own way. Bring a keeper to it.

n_rooted.text: The young Mother settles in the nest clearing.

l_storm.text: The big egg. It is cracking. Pieter, the book. Write the hour.

l_storm2.text: Wings. A Storm Sire. The first one ever bred by a man. Root him by her, and she will lay for him.

l_hatch.text: Hatchlings. They will sit in the canopy and watch the river for me. Nobody looks up at a bird.

p_ready.text: They are all in the forest, Doctor. Quiet. I can hear the oars.

p_warn.text: The canoes are rounding the point, Doctor. Not long now.

n_land.text: The commission lands: musketeers in purple, a magistrate in black, and a man with a map case who looks at the ground before he looks at the house.

f_land.text: Doctor Lindqvist. I carry an order of the Holy See and of His Majesty. You know its contents.

l_land.text: Sugar, Desembargador. Sugar and a few goats. Search what you like.

v_land.text: I have seen what you keep, Doctor. On the mountain. I will know its prints.

v_land_w.text: I do not know what I am looking for, Doctor. So I will look at everything.

p_still.text: Keep them still, Doctor. A still animal in the forest is a shadow. A moving one is an animal.

l_dinner.text: The Desembargador has come a long way. He will be hungry. I will ask him to dine.

f_dinner.text: Dinner? Well. The search can spare its magistrate for an hour. Sergeant, your men with me.

v_dinner.text: Go and eat, Desembargador. I am not hungry.

f_dinner_end.text: A fine table, Doctor. Now. Back to work, men.

p_decoy.text: A lure post at the west point, or at the old chapel, and they will go and look at it. Men always go and look.

n_decoy.text: A lure post set. A search party turns off its road to see what it is.

n_party.text: A search party is coming near a pen. Keep them still, or move them away under a lure.

n_found.text: Found. They have seen one of the stock. Get it away under a lure before they shoot it.

p_riders.text: The riders have crossed the creek at the west ford, Doctor. They are going up the paths now.

v_hunch.text: Everything on this island walks from the middle out. We look in the middle.

v_tracks.text: Fresh prints. Three toes, a dragged claw. This way.

v_found.text: There. You see it? Sugar and goats, the Doctor said.

l_found.text: No. Not that one. Pieter, move them. Move the others.

p_half.text: They have found half of them, Doctor. If they find many more, they will burn the pens and the house with them.

p_dusk.text: The light is going. They will not search the forest in the dark.

n_night.text: Night. The commission camps at the landing to leave at dawn. Fires, a guard, the goats penned by the boats.

p_restless.text: Doctor! One of the young is up. It smells the goats. It is going for the camp!

l_restless.text: A lure under its nose, right under it, or it will not turn. If it reaches those goats they will see everything.

l_held.text: Got it. Easy now. Back to the forest, slowly.

p_back.text: It is back in the forest, Doctor. It is lying down.

n_fight.text: The young one is among the goats. A sentry fires; the camp is up with torches; the forest is full of eyes.

v_fight.text: Torches! Into the forest, all of you! Now we know where they are.

p_lost.text: They have found nearly all of them, Doctor. They are bringing the pitch for the pens.

n_dawn.text: Dawn. The commission walks down to its canoes.

f_dawn.text: We found what we found, Doctor. It will all be in my report, and in Rome.

v_dawn.text: You did not breed them, Doctor. Nobody breeds a thing like that. Somebody made it, long ago, and it is still being made.

v_c1.text: Three parties, Desembargador: the west paths, the middle and the east. The riders take the fields. I follow the prints.

v_c_tip.text: They sleep in the clearings in the day. Walk close, and have your muskets ready: a sleeping one sees you at three steps.

v_c_tracks.text: Pale claw marks on the ground are fresh prints. They lead to the ones that walk.

f_c_dinner.text: The Doctor asks me to dine. I will go, Valadares. Somebody must watch the man himself.

v_c_night.text: Night. They will move in the dark: watch the camp and the goats.

v_c_won.text: Enough. Burn the pens. Write it down, Desembargador: we found them.

v_c_lost.text: Dawn, and the canoes. We found too little. He will say we found nothing.

l_end1.text: They left at dawn. The Desembargador wrote his report. Valadares wrote another.

l_end_all.text: They found nothing. Nothing. I stood at the landing and waved my hat.

l_end_some.text: They found some, and burned what they found. The rest lay in the forest and did not move.

l_end_few.text: They found most of them. I watched the pens burn from the house. I kept what was left.

l_end_storm.text: And the Storm Sire flew over the canopy every evening after, and came back to the lure.

k_end1.text: He tells it as if he won. Valadares found more than he thinks. Valadares found enough to know what was on that island.

k_end2.text: And Lindqvist still believes the thing evolved. The Church told him what it was. He did not listen then either.

v_end_c.text: We burned the pens we found. The Doctor stood at the landing with his hat in his hand, and did not look at the smoke.

k_end_c.text: He told me Valadares found nothing. Valadares found enough.

v_end_c_lost.text: We left at dawn with half a report. I knew they were there. I could smell them.

n_lost.text: The commission has found the stock. By Rome's order the pens are burned.

h_hurt.text: My leg. Pieter, the lures. Keep them together.

n_guards.text: Lindqvist's guards are Assembly men now, paid in sugar and silence.

n_no_pieter.text: Pieter did not come back from the mountain. Two keepers carry the lures.

new_pterodactyl.text: NEW: THE STORM SIRE. A flying father: up, he flies and dives to bite; ROOTED beside the Mother he lands, and she lays the eggs of his line.

new_hatchlings.text: NEW: THE HATCHLINGS. Pick them on the Mother's card while the Storm Sire is rooted by her: little flyers, two to an egg. They bite only flyers, but they see far over the forest.

island.caption: An island below Óbidos, the dry season 2772: the fazenda.

pens.caption: The pens in the forest, and the lure.

storm.caption: The Storm Sire over the canopy.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King and his prisoner, the doctor.

text: The lower Amazon, the dry season 2772. You are Lindqvist's breeding stock on his island, and the people who keep it with the lures.
The creatures obey only near a lure. Walk them from the old pens into the deep forest before the Crown's commission lands, then keep them still and hidden until it leaves at dawn.
Nothing bites while the commission is on the island. If it finds three quarters of the stock, Rome's order is carried out.
The lower Amazon, the dry season 2772. You are the Crown's commission: Duarte Valadares, Desembargador Fonseca and their musketeers, with Rome's order.
Search the island. Find the specimens Lindqvist hides in the forest and destroy half of them before your canoes leave at dawn. Valadares must live.

stock.title: The Island
stock.text: The commission left at dawn. It found {found} of the {young_n} young; {unfound} were never found.

text_if.text: The Storm Sire hatched on the island.
The magistrate dined at the big house.

commission.title: Found
commission.text: The commission found {found} specimens and destroyed {destroyed} by Rome's order.
